Bug_Explanation: The code contains intentional resource leaks in methods showBug1, showBug2, and showBug3. In showBug1, the BufferedReader is not guaranteed to be closed if an exception occurs before reaching the close call. In showBug2, only the last FileOutputStream is closed, while others are leaked if an exception occurs. In showBug3, the Stream returned by Files.lines is not closed, leading to a resource leak.
Trigger_Explanation: The tests trigger the bug by calling the showBug method which internally calls showBug1, showBug2, and showBug3. These methods contain resource leaks as they do not properly close the resources.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results indicate that all three tests passed without throwing any exceptions, even though they were expecting IOExceptions. This suggests that the resource leaks did not cause any IOExceptions during the test execution, and thus the bug was not triggered as expected based on the provided test results.
